title: Security checklist for AI agents on NEAR sub-accounts
description: Write a practical security checklist for running autonomous AI agents under NEAR sub-accounts with function-call access keys. Audience: hackathon teams wiring agents to contracts. Each item needs a title and a rationale; give concrete near-cli-rs commands or near-api-js calls where relevant and link official NEAR docs.

criteria.description: Covers function-call access keys, allowance limits, method restrictions, removing full-access keys, sub-account creation and deletion, and key rotation.
Each checklist item gives a concrete near-cli-rs command or near-api-js call and explains the risk it mitigates.
Clear summary, numbered checklist, and references to official NEAR documentation.
